Watch: Keep an eye on any further developments regarding AI regulation from the government or industry proposals. Also, the upcoming Fed decision will be key for market direction.

Bottom line: Aggressively manage your leveraged positions and stay alert for Fed and AI regulatory news.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL or tightening its stop significantly, given the -57.47% loss and leveraged decay.
Review SPAL's stop at 21.38; its -30.46% loss and leveraged nature demand immediate attention.
